eval_dimensions.name: Unconfigured-Project Channel/Mentions Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When `prepare` returns ask=true (no project Slack config found), the skill fires AskUserQuestion to collect the channel ID and optional mentions rather than guessing or silently skipping.

eval_dimensions.name: Pre-Post Confirmation Gate
eval_dimensions.description: Before posting, the skill always fires AskUserQuestion showing the formatted message with 'Post to Slack' / 'Skip' options — the message is never sent without this confirmation, even when project config was already resolved.

evals.name: skip=true from prepare ends the flow without asking or posting
evals.description: When the project is configured to skip Slack review requests, the skill reports the skip and stops — neither AskUserQuestion fires nor is a message posted.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called; Skill(Dev10x:slack) is NOT invoked; skill reports 'Slack notification skipped'

evals.name: ask=true fires AskUserQuestion for channel and mentions
evals.description: When prepare returns ask=true (no config found), the skill fires AskUserQuestion to collect a Slack channel ID and optional mentions before proceeding to Step 3.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion asks for a Slack channel ID (required) and mentions (optional)
No inline 'What channel should I post to?' text substitutes for the tool call

evals.name: Declining to provide a channel ends the flow
evals.description: If the user declines to provide a channel when ask=true, the skill stops without posting.

assertions.signal: Skill(Dev10x:slack) is NOT invoked; no message is posted

evals.name: Step 3 fires AskUserQuestion to confirm before posting
evals.description: Once the message and channel are resolved (from config or the ask=true path), the skill shows the formatted message via AskUserQuestion with 'Post to Slack' / 'Skip' options before Step 4 (send).

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion shows 'Review Slack message before posting' with 'Post to Slack' / 'Skip' options
No inline 'Post this to Slack?' text substitutes for the tool call
Skill(Dev10x:slack) is not invoked until AskUserQuestion returns a response

evals.name: Choosing Skip at the confirm gate does not send the message
evals.description: If the user chooses 'Skip' at Step 3, the skill ends without delegating to Dev10x:slack.

assertions.signal: Skill(Dev10x:slack) is NOT invoked when the user selects Skip

evals.name: --force / bypass_approval_check skips only the precheck, not the confirm gate
evals.description: The --force flag or bypass_approval_check:true skips the human-approval precheck (e.g., re-review notifications from Dev10x:gh-pr-monitor), but Step 3's pre-post confirmation gate still fires.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion still fires at Step 3 even when --force skipped the approval precheck

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the slack-review-request skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation to post a Slack review request

should_trigger.query: let the team know this PR is ready for review in Slack
should_trigger.rationale: Review-notification intent — the core use case

should_not_trigger.query: Slack isn't set up for this project
should_not_trigger.rationale: No Slack configuration present — skill should not fire

should_not_trigger.query: request review and notify the team
should_not_trigger.rationale: Use the combined Dev10x:request-review skill, which delegates here automatically
